headline: Kenya President Ruto Directs KPC to Withdraw Suit Over Sh3B Spill Payout
summary: President William Ruto instructed the state-owned Kenya Pipeline Company to withdraw a court case that delayed Sh3 billion in compensation for over 3,000 residents affected by a 2015 oil spill.
why: Kenya Pipeline Company operates the national petroleum transport and storage network; executive settlement directives clarify state-backed corporate liabilities.

impacts.name: Kenya Pipeline Company
impacts.why: Withdrawing the litigation will obligate the state company to pay out Sh3 billion in compensation.
